name: ooxml-ledger
description: Edit Office documents and prove no edit went unrecorded
long_description: Edits .docx, .pptx, and .xlsx files and enforces an accountability gate: `commit_document` refuses to seal a receipt if the document changed in a way no recorded operation explains, unless a human explicitly forces and thereby records the override. `verify` and `digest` are stateless, so the same check that guards an interactive edit also runs in CI. Fourteen tools cover the full loop: open a document, inspect its structure and paragraph text, preview and apply text/paragraph edits, commit with a sealed receipt, and independently verify or export that receipt later. Every path argument is resolved inside the configured document root and refused outside it.

documentRoot.title: Document root
documentRoot.description: Folder the server may read and write inside. Every path argument the server receives is resolved inside this folder and refused outside it — a drag-and-drop install has no working directory to fall back on, so this must be set explicitly. Pick the folder that holds (or will hold) the Office documents you want edited.

readOnly.title: Read-only mode
readOnly.description: When enabled, only server_info, digest, verify, and list_receipts are available — no session, edit, or write tools are registered at all (not merely hidden). Use this for CI or for reviewing documents without any write surface.

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Report tool, canon, and receipt-schema versions, the active roots, and whether the server is read-only.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open a .docx/.pptx/.xlsx file inside the configured root and start an editing session.

tools.name: close_document
tools.description: End a session, optionally discarding any unsaved changes.

tools.name: describe_structure
tools.description: Report the paragraph/part structure of the document open in a session.

tools.name: find_text
tools.description: Search paragraph text in the open document and return addressable paragraph IDs and hashes.

tools.name: preview_edits
tools.description: Report what a batch of text edits would do, without touching the document.

tools.name: apply_edits
tools.description: Apply a batch of text edits all-or-nothing and journal the operation.

tools.name: delete_paragraph
tools.description: Delete one paragraph addressed by its ID (or index + hash) and journal the operation.

tools.name: insert_paragraph
tools.description: Insert one paragraph beside an anchor paragraph (addressed by ID + hash) and journal the operation.

tools.name: commit_document
tools.description: Seal a receipt for the session's changes; refuses if the document changed in a way no recorded operation explains, unless forced.

tools.name: list_receipts
tools.description: List the sealed receipts recorded for a document.

tools.name: export_receipt
tools.description: Write a receipt out to a .json file inside the configured root.

tools.name: digest
tools.description: Compute the canonical digest of a document. Stateless — needs no open session.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Independently verify a document against a receipt, including any recorded force-override. Stateless.
